The University of Melbourne, John Vickery Scholarship 2025 is an initiative by the University of Melbourne, Australia for second or third-year students enrolled in Painting or Drawing in the discipline of Art. The scholarship aims to support students based on artistic merit, academic achievements and financial needs. The selected students will receive a single payment of up to $5,000 (approx. 4,27,325).
To be eligible, an applicant must:-
be currently in the second or third year of study within the Painting or Drawing program at the Faculty of Fine Arts and Music
have a proven track record of academic excellence
be able to clearly articulate and document their financial circumstances
have not received any other major Faculty of Fine Arts and Music scholarships or awards
The selected students will receive a single payment of up to $50,000 (approx. 4,27,325).

Question: What is the John Vickery Scholarship?

The John Vickery Scholarship is a financial aid opportunity offered by the University of Melbourne's Faculty of Fine Art and Music. It supports second or third-year undergraduate students specializing in Painting or Drawing.
Question: Who funds the John Vickery Scholarship?
This scholarship is funded by the University of Melbourne, through the Faculty of Fine Art and Music.
Question: When will I be notified of the John Vickery Scholarship outcome?
Applicants can generally expect to receive notification of the scholarship outcome approximately four weeks after the application deadline.
Question: Are recommendation letters required for this scholarship?
Recommendation letters are not a standard requirement for this scholarship, but the application process may change. Always refer to the official university documentation.
Question: Can I save my application and return to it later
Yes, the online application portal allows you to save your progress and return to it before submission, however ensure that it is submitted before the final deadline.
